config_verbatim:
# Pipeline smoke-test cell -- NOT a reportable number.
#
# `data/prime-mini` is a 10,000-node subset of PRIME: all 599 nodes that are
# a gold answer to one of the 280 `test-0.1` queries, plus 9,401 distractors
# sampled from the candidate list (seed 20260819). `candidates.json` is
# filtered to exactly those 10,000 and `edges.jsonl` to the 85,524 edges with
# both endpoints inside the subset, so `upsert_relationships` cannot raise
# `MissingEntityError`. The query files are symlinks -- there is one copy.
#
# ## Read the scores as a floor on nothing and a check on everything
#
# A 10,000-candidate pool is a 13x easier retrieval problem than PRIME's
# 129,375, so every metric here is INFLATED against the real arms and the two
# must never appear in the same table. What this cell is for is the other
# thing: it exercises prefixes, dimension, table keying, the chunker, the
# graph load and the stark_qa sidecar end to end in ~6 minutes per arm rather
# than ~90, on a model no arm in this repo has ever run.
#
# Every real bug in this project has been silent and surfaced only because a
# number looked wrong. This is the cheapest place to find the next one.
#
# Arm against arm within the mini set is still meaningful -- the three mini
# configs differ only in chunker, exactly as the full sweep does.
name: qwen-mini-boundary
dataset: prime-mini
split: test-0.1
chunker: boundary-preference
embeddings: qwen3-embedding-0.6b
dimension: 1024
aggregation: max
agent: dense
k: 20

# See `qwen-wholedoc.yaml` for why the document side is empty and the query
# side carries an instruction. Every qwen config states both.
document_prefix: ""
query_prefix: "Instruct: Given a query, retrieve relevant documents that answer the query\nQuery: "
